name: embry0
description: Stand up embry0, connect Claude Code to it over MCP, and set it up from the chat window.

url.title: embry0 URL
url.description: The dashboard origin of the deployment, without a trailing slash: http://localhost:8200 on the machine that runs it, or its public origin over https (the key travels in a header). The MCP endpoint is /mcp on it.

api_key.title: embry0 API key
api_key.description: An API key from the dashboard (Settings, then API keys). Scope admin to set the deployment up; read or operate to use it. Leave it empty to stand up a new deployment first with /embry0:install, which fills it in.
